business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Importation of Deep-Frozen Meat Carcasses and Pelagic Fish

CARICOM Agreement on the Harmonisation of Investment Incentives

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering (Prevention and Control) Act, Chapter 119 (Revised Edition 2020), as amended; International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270 (Revised Edition 2011), as amended by the IBC (Amendment) Act 2022; Beneficial Ownership Regulations 2022; Central Bank of Belize AML/CFT Guidelines

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of the passport holder, or competent passport authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry in the home jurisdiction of the corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents of Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home jurisdiction company registry or authorized corporate service provider

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Register of Directors / Officers of Corporate Shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of Physical Address of Each Shareholder / Director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company or licensed bank in the address jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, signatories and relevant beneficial parties must be screened against the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Specially Designated Nationals list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, EU and CARICOM consolidated restrictive measures, and the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) domestic watchlist. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any identified Politically Exposed Person and must be completed prior to incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Belize Companies Registry and International Business Company Registry online name-search portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All proposed names must be in English or in a Latin-script transliteration. Names originating in non-Latin scripts must be fully transliterated into Latin characters. The selected corporate name must carry a statutorily recognized corporate suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', or 'Incorporated'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 days of a name rejection, the applicant must file a written application for reconsideration with the Registrar of Companies. The application must state the statutory grounds of objection and include any required prior ministerial or sectoral approval letter where the rejected name contained a sensitive token. Where rejection is based on colourable resemblance to an existing name, the applicant may resubmit a modified name or procure a written consent from the prior registrant and annex it to the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible as the registered office address provided a locally licensed registered agent is engaged and maintains physical custody of the statutory records. For a wholesale importer of frozen beef and seafood operating as an International Business Company, no physical cold-chain facility or logistics warehouse in Belize is required to satisfy the registered office mandate.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: approximate 15-20% chance of unannounced physical inspection within the first three years of operation. The probability is elevated if the registered agent identifies suspicious activity or if the company fails to satisfy economic substance expectations under the International Business Companies Act.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act (Chapter 270 of the Laws of Belize), Revised Edition 2011, as amended; Sections 3 (Incorporation), 6 (Articles of Incorporation), and 27 (Registered Office and Registered Agent); Companies Act Chapter 250 for domestic companies, not applicable to IBCs.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registry, Belize Business Enterprise Registry, Ministry of Finance and Business Development, Belize City, Belize.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form IBC/1) submitted with Registered Agent Certificate and Consent of Director.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; capital may be denominated in any currency and need not be paid at incorporation. No escrow account or deposit requirement is imposed by the IBC Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers adopt the Articles of Incorporation as filed and accept the issued share subscription allotment. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office located at the address of the licensed registered agent be and is hereby confirmed and the registered agent appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER that the managing director and a corporate secretary are appointed with full authority to conduct banking, execute contracts, and manage the wholesale frozen beef and seafood import business. RESOLVED FURTHER that all officers may sign filings, open settlement accounts, and take ancillary actions to complete incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Approved by Belize Business Enterprise Registry; agent must hold a valid IBC license.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent engagement letter and provide due diligence information. The agent reviews the proposed company name, verifies director and shareholder identities, and prepares the incorporation kit. All natural persons must submit passport and proof of address; corporations must submit certificate of good standing.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of each director and shareholder
Proof of residential address for each individual
Certificate of good standing for corporate shareholders
Financial references for ultimate beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If due diligence is queried, provide notarized apostilled originals and supplementary bank reference promptly to the agent; re-submission is made via the agent to the registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Name Search Unit, Belize Companies Registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed names, with 'Limited' or 'Ltd' as suffix, through the registered agent. The registry searches its database and, if availability is confirmed, issues a Name Reservation Letter valid for 30 days. The name must not be misleading or identical to an existing corporate name.
required_dossiers: Public information form listing proposed names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is refused, file an alternative name under the same application number; submit documentary support of official consent when the objection is based on a similar existing mark.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Incorporation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public licensed in Belize acting in accordance with the Notaries Public Act.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation, which include proposed company name, share structure, registered office address, registered agent name, and statement of intended activities limited to wholesale import and distribution of frozen beef and seafood. Each subscriber signs before the notary, who certifies the declaration.
required_dossiers: Consent of corporate secretary or statement of no secretary
Declaration of notarization and acting acceptance form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary notes defects, correct the signature blocks and resubmit to the same notary; if a registry pattern discrepancy is identified, the agent will immediately coordinate amendment of the Articles and re-notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: International Companies Section, Belize Companies Registry, Belize City.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed Articles of Incorporation and accompanying consent forms, together with the required filing fee receipt. Filing may be submitted by physical courier or through the registry's approved agent portal. The statutory fee of USD 500 (payable in Belize dollars at the official rate) is remitted by the agent on behalf of the company.
required_dossiers: Covering letter from the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query, the agent submits a formal response letter within 48 hours addressing the noted omission; if fees are disputed, provide proof of tender and the registry's official fee schedule.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon successful registration, the registry issues a Certificate of Incorporation. The agent obtains certified copies, statutory registers, share certificates, and the corporate seal if requested. The company must maintain registers at the registered office and hold physical or written consents in accordance with the IBC Act.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a minor typographical error, file a Request for Reissue with the registry and return the original certificate; no substantive re-examination is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of First Board Resolution and Commencement of Foreign Trade Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the IBC; subsequently the Belize Trade and Investment Development Service (BELTRAIDE) for exporter-importer registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, adopt the pro-forma resolution, and instruct officers to open dedicated settlement accounts and complete the commercial registration. The IBC files a Business Registration Notification with BELTRAIDE for statistical and trade facilitation purposes; the company also applies for a Tax Identification Number solely for customs clearance if physical imports will pass through Belize customs territory.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting or unanimous written resolution
Certificate of good standing of the IBC
Director and beneficial owner identification records
Business activity statement describing wholesale frozen meat and seafood import
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If BELTRAIDE or customs registration is delayed, file a request for accelerated review with the Customs Comptroller and maintain the IBC certificate as evidence of corporate standing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Belize Bureau of Standards, Ministry of Economic Development and Investment; import permits additionally coordinated with the Belize Agricultural Health Authority (BAHA) and Belize Customs Department.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Import and Wholesale Establishment Licence under the Food Safety Act and the Belize Bureau of Standards food labeling and cold storage regulations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration (Low-Impact Category); a full EIA Report is not required for wholesale refrigerated warehouse operations but an Environmental Compliance Plan may be mandated for cold-storage units exceeding 500 m2 or using ammonia-based refrigeration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with the Effluent Limitations Regulations under the Environmental Protection Act (BZ standards: pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 ≤ 50 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L). Refrigerant systems using HCFCs or ammonia must comply with the Ozone Depleting Substances Regulations and a leak-prevention plan; all food waste must be handled through licensed waste contractors and cannot be disposed into municipal drains.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Belize Fire Service confirming installation of Class A/B fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and automatic detection alarm in the cold-storage warehouse; structural load safety inspection issued by the Belize Building Division for floor loading; workplace health clearance from the Ministry of Health and Wellness confirming temperature-controlled worker safety, thermal protective gear, and sanitation protocols under the Workplace Health and Safety Act.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service (Ministry of Finance), corporate registry interface via Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry; online portal: https://taxservices.gov.bz
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned IBC obtains a Tax Identification Number (TIN) by submitting the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered office address confirmation, and a board resolution appointing a local registered agent to the Belize Tax Service; apply on GST Form-01 simultaneously to enable customs clearance; the TIN is issued within 5–10 business days and is linked to the Customs ASYCUDA importer code; no physical presence or resident director is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (offshore IBC regime governing international trading income; physical importation of frozen goods into Belize triggers customs duty and GST import levy on the IBC as importer of record while the corporate entity itself retains zero-tax status on foreign-source income)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under the International Business Companies (Amendment) Act, an IBC may irrevocably elect in writing to the Belize Tax Service to be taxed as a domestic resident company (subject to Income Tax at 25% and Business Tax at 1.75% of gross receipts); no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists in Belize domestic law; conversion to a domestic company is subject to Ministerial consent and payment of a BZD 3,000 conversion fee.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: General Sales Tax (GST) under the General Sales Tax Act, Chapter 64, administered jointly with the Customs Department for import VAT
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 75,000 in annual taxable supplies for domestic vendors; however, any importer, including a tax-exempt IBC, must register for GST immediately upon first importation to clear goods through customs, with no de minimis threshold applying to import transactions
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No statutory real-time e-invoicing or fiscal clearance mandate exists; Belize Customs operates ASYCUDA World for electronic import/export declarations and risk-based clearance; GST invoices must be serially numbered paper or PDF documents carrying the GST registration number and are audited periodically without digital stamping or API-based fiscal reporting.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Belize within 30 days of supply qualify for 0% GST under section 25 of the General Sales Tax Act; the exporter must hold the customs-stamped export declaration, transport documentation, and foreign-currency payment evidence; offshore services supplied to non-residents and wholly consumed outside Belize also qualify; an IBC re-exporting imported frozen beef or seafood must document the original import GST paid and claim a refund via GST Form-15R within 12 months of the export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA CUSDEC with electronic validation)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Belize
Commercial Invoice and Packing List matching the container seal and cold-chain manifest
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT credit advice showing foreign-currency payment receipt
Certificate of Origin (where preferential tariff treatment or zero-rating is claimed)
Temperature logger and reefer container records for deep-frozen cargo substantiation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under GST Act sections 64–67, a fraudulent export zero-rating claim triggers retrospective assessment of 12.5% GST plus interest at 8% per annum and a civil penalty of 200% of the tax evaded; criminal conviction carries a fine up to BZD 50,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; the Customs Comptroller may additionally seize the goods, suspend the TIN, and disqualify the registered agent for export declaration fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (CBB), acting as the exchange-control authority under the Central Bank of Belize Act (Cap. 262) and the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 36), with functional supervisory interface to the International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) for offshore and international banking licence matters.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Belize maintains a fixed exchange-rate regime of BZD 2.00 = USD 1.00. The current account is convertible for genuine trade in goods and services, supported by commercial invoices, bills of lading and corresponding import permits. Capital-account transfers by Belize-resident persons generally require CBB permission; however, an International Business Company (IBC) is treated as external for exchange-control purposes, so a non-resident-funded IBC holding foreign-currency accounts outside the Belize-dollar system is not subject to routine CBB conversion approval. Profit and dividend remittances by an IBC are permitted as current-account transfers where the IBC generates no Belize-source income; the paying bank requires a board resolution, the current tax-exemption certificate, corporate good standing and confirmation that the IBC is not conducting business with Belize residents or with local customers. The principal convertibility hurdles are proof of external status, absence of prohibited local business under the IBC Act, and satisfaction of the correspondent bank's independent AML/KYC due diligence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act and the Exchange Control (Export of Goods) Regulations, a resident exporter earning foreign currency from Belize exports must remit the proceeds through an authorised dealer and surrender 100% of the foreign-exchange proceeds to the Central Bank of Belize within 90 days of export or collection, unless the CBB has expressly granted a retention allowance. This surrender obligation applies to resident exporters of goods; the present ISIC 4632 frozen-beef and seafood mandate is an import-trade treasury, not an export-remittance centre. An IBC structured with external status is exempt from surrender only to the extent the proceeds are derived from non-Belize sources and remain in an external foreign-currency account. Any physical export of goods from Belize arranged through a resident entity would trigger the statutory surrender requirement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Account
Operational USD Account / Escrow for Trade Settlement

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low for any unlicensed or unregulated offshore digital EMI; Medium for a fully licensed foreign EMI used only as a supplementary payment channel. Belize has no domestic electronic-money-institution licensing regime, and foreign EMIs cannot passport into Belize under CBB banking law. An IBC that relies solely on an overseas fintech EMI would expose the treasury to local money-transmission licensing risk and would not support documentary trade instruments such as commercial letters of credit. Therefore, the primary treasury rail must remain a licensed Belize commercial bank with active SWIFT/correspondent clearing capacity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of the directors is not an absolute statutory requirement where the IBC is introduced by a licensed registered agent or corporate service provider, but CBB-supervised banks uniformly require a live video interview with the ultimate beneficial owner and at least one director. In practice, a physical visit to Belize may be required by the bank's AML committee where the applicant is personally introduced by an unregulated firm, where the UBO is in a high-risk jurisdiction, or where the corporate ownership structure involves nominee shareholders. Remote onboarding is feasible with notarised corporate documents, apostilled resolutions, certified passports and a regulated introducer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore vehicle opacity: Belize IBC with nominee shareholders, historical bearer instruments or incomplete beneficial-ownership disclosure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, Certificate of Incumbency, register of directors and members, beneficial-ownership register or declaration, notarised passports and residential proofs for all UBOs, written confirmation that no bearer shares are outstanding, and a registered-agent due-diligence letter from the licensed Belize corporate service provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Food-commodity trade risk: frozen beef and pelagic-fish import invoices from third-party shell suppliers, inconsistent shipping routes, or missing sanitary and customs records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master supply agreement with the recognised producer/processor; commercial purchase order and invoice; bill of lading or airway bill; packing list; sanitary and phytosanitary certificates; Belize Agricultural Health Authority (BAHA) import permit; customs-coded tariff documentation for HTS 0202 and HTS 0303; reefer-temperature log; marine or cold-chain insurance certificate; and the named ultimate customer or warehouse receipt.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP or adverse-media correlation in the ownership chain, supplier base, or settlement corridor.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent OFAC, UN, EU and UK sanctions screening results for all beneficial owners, directors, suppliers, customers and banks; adverse-media and PEP reports from a recognised screening database; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; politically-exposed-person declarations; passport verifications; legal-entity identifier where available; and a commitment to enhanced transaction monitoring.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual treasury patterns: rapid round-tripping of capital, threshold structuring, unrelated third-party payments, or cash-like settlement for high-value frozen-food cargo.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury and FX policy; group-structure diagram; capitalisation schedule; source-of-funds documentation for every inbound capital injection; complete trade file for each outbound disbursement; import customs declarations; supplier bank-details confirmation; and an audit trail matching SWIFT references to invoices and LC numbers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Residency contamination: IBC transacting with Belize residents, holding local real estate without licence, or earning Belize-source income, thereby triggering tax and exchange-control exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or notarised management accounts confirming no Belize-resident customers; registered-office and registered-agent filings; external-status confirmation from the CBB-compliant bank; board minutes restricting local business; proof that the import goods are sold outside Belize or through an exempt trade corridor; and the IBC tax-exemption certificate.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital from non-resident shareholders must be routed by SWIFT MT103 or Fedwire to the IBC's USD-denominated external account at the Belize commercial bank. The payment narrative should expressly state 'Capital contribution – equity subscription' or 'Shareholder loan facility' in alignment with BPM6 direct-investment classification; Belize does not publish a domestic purpose-code lexicon, so banks accept an ISO 20022 transaction-purpose descriptor such as 'Direct Investment Equity' where the correspondent bank requires a structured code. CBB approval is not required for a properly characterised external-IBC capital account, but the receiving bank will require the corporate resolution authorising the account, the capitalisation schedule, source-of-wealth evidence from the shareholder, confirmation of beneficial ownership, and a current certificate of good standing.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail for frozen-beef and pelagic-fish trade payables is an irrevocable commercial letter of credit issued by the Belize bank in favour of the foreign supplier under UCP600, communicated by SWIFT MT700 or MT710, and settled against compliant documents through SWIFT MT103 or MT202 COVER. For open-account settlements, a straightforward corporate-to-corporate SWIFT MT103 from the IBC's USD account is used, with the reference field clearly identifying the commercial invoice, bill of lading, and LC number where applicable. Belize commercial banks will require each outbound disbursement to be supported by the purchase contract, commercial invoice, cold-chain shipping documents, BAHA import approval and customs reconciliation. Payments must be made only to the named supplier's bank account; any routing through a third party must be supported by a contractual funds-flow explanation and bank-approved trade documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/BZD forward foreign-exchange contract with a licensed Belize commercial bank, supported by genuine underlying import exposure and documentary proof of the trade payable.

Cross-currency forward contract on USD/EUR, USD/GBP or USD/JPY where the frozen-beef or seafood supplier invoices in a non-USD currency, provided the underlying contract and invoice are presented to the bank.

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on USD/BZD transacted with an offshore regulated bank under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement; local Belize banks do not operate a liquid BZD forward market, and the NDF must be used strictly as an economic hedge, not for speculative positions.

FX swap or cross-currency swap (CCS) with an approved international counterparty under ISDA documentation, used to match the IBC's USD funding with non-USD trade-payable cash flows, subject to board-approved treasury policy and counterparty credit limits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (IBC Form AR) and Annual License Fee Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Government of Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual license fee due on the anniversary date of incorporation; the Annual Return must be filed within 3 months immediately following the anniversary date. No fiscal-year-end filing is required.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment within 30 days after the anniversary attracts a 10% surcharge on the annual fee; continued non-payment results in additional prescribed penalties of up to BZ$100 per month. If arrears remain unpaid for 6 consecutive months, the Registrar publishes a strike-off notice, and the company is dissolved after the notice period with assets forfeited to the Crown.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Declaration (Director's Solvency and Compliance Declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize-licensed registered agent; declaration is held at the registered office and is available to CCAR upon inspection or together with the Annual Return submission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation, delivered to the registered agent within the same 3-month Annual Return filing window.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-delivery of the declaration permits the registered agent to resign under the IBC Act; resignation triggers a 90-day period after which the Registrar strikes off the company if no replacement agent is appointed. Non-compliance also constitutes a records-keeping offence punishable by a fine of up to BZ$10,000.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Register and Register of Members Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Beneficial Ownership Section
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous filing obligation: any share transfer, member change, or beneficial ownership change must be filed with CCAR within 30 days of the event. The Annual Return serves as the annual confirmation that the UBO register is complete and accurate as of the anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file an updated Register of Members or Register of Beneficial Owners is a criminal offence, punishable by a fine of up to BZ$10,000 plus BZ$100 for each day of continuing default. Persistent non-compliance may result in suspension of filings and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Notification / Nil Return (Non-Tax-Resident Exemption Claim)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Economic Substance Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the end of each financial year. A nil return or exemption notification is required annually even where the IBC is not tax resident in Belize and carries on no relevant activity in-country.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Missed or late Economic Substance filing attracts an initial administrative penalty of US$500, increasing to US$5,000 for repeated defaults. The Registrar may also strike off the company for continued non-compliance, and information may be exchanged with foreign tax authorities.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit applies to a 'small IBC': fewer than 20 members, no securities offered or listed on a public stock exchange, no corporate beneficial owner that is a public company or regulated financial institution. A mandatory audit is triggered only for a 'large IBC' or where members holding at least 10% of voting shares demand an audit under section 78 of the IBC Act. This frozen beef and seafood import structure is typically structured as a small IBC and remains audit-exempt unless shareholder-requested.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS applies to audited financial statements. Where no audit is required, the IBC must still prepare and retain management accounts on an IFRS or consistent accruals basis that reflect the financial position of the company; these accounts must be delivered to the registered agent within 12 months of the financial year end under the IBC (Amendment) Regulations 2021.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no standalone annual UBO form in Belize. The Annual Return and the Director's Annual Declaration, both due within 3 months after the anniversary of incorporation, operate jointly as the annual confirmation that the shareholding and beneficial ownership registers are accurate. Any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership during the year must be filed with CCAR within 30 days. For this offshore frozen beef and seafood import entity, the shareholder declaration and nominee arrangements must be re-certified annually to the registered agent, but no public UBO disclosure is made.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors' Shareholdings and Interests

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$1,200 - US$2,800 per annum for a Belize-licensed registered agent bundle including registered office, nominee officers, Annual Return preparation, and UBO register updates; discount online incorporation services range US$800 - US$1,200.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$4,000 - US$12,000 for a full IFRS audit by a Belize or internationally affiliated auditor; US$1,500 - US$3,500 for a certified accountant's compilation or review where no audit is legally triggered.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for IBCs (full offshore tax exemption under the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270); Belize resident corporate income tax headline rate is 25% under the Income Tax Act, Cap. 55 for domestic taxable companies
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IBC tax-exempt zone: no income tax, no business tax, no capital gains tax, no estate/inheritance tax, no stamp duty on IBC instruments, and no exchange control on currency flows; the exemption is contractually guaranteed for 50 years from incorporation; it is conditional on deriving no Belize-source income and on conducting no trade with Belize residents; any Belize-sourced revenue is treated as taxable at 25% and may retroactively void the exemption

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Return and Annual License Fee (IBC Act, Cap. 270, s. 75) — filed and paid through the Belize Companies Registry / Registry of International Business Companies online portal; no corporate income tax return is required because the IBC is tax-exempt
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before 31 August of each calendar year for existing IBCs; newly incorporated IBCs pay a pro-rated fee at incorporation; the license fee is computed on authorized share capital

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Company Name and IBC Registration No.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered legal name of the IBC and the unique registration number issued by the Registry
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact certificate name; do not abbreviate; ensure the name matches bank KYC records and the ESR filing

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed registered agent's physical street address and postal address in Belize
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the registered agent's Belize address; a standalone PO Box is not acceptable

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and identification details of all directors and officers
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; the use of nominee directors is disclosed here and attracts enhanced AML scrutiny

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of the principal commercial activity; for this entity: cross-border wholesale import and resale of deep-frozen beef carcasses and pelagic fish
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'international trading conducted outside Belize'; any description implying domestic Belize trade will void the statutory tax exemption

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory declaration that the IBC derived no income from Belize, held no Belize real property, and transacted no business with Belize residents during the period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be countersigned by the licensed registered agent; a false attestation is a criminal offense and grounds for immediate strike-off

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or underpayment of the annual license fee attracts a 50% surcharge on the unpaid amount; persistent default results in striking-off from the Registry, loss of legal capacity to contract, reinstatement fees plus court costs, and exposure of assets to escheat or creditor claims

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Belize Economic Substance Return (ESR Notification and Declaration) — filed discretely through the Belize Tax Service (BTS) online portal under the International Business Companies (Economic Substance) Rules, 2019
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: ESR notification must be submitted within 6 months of incorporation or commencement of a relevant activity; the full ESR return must be filed within 12 months after the end of each financial period (fiscal year-end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IBC name, registration number, Belize Tax Service TIN, and registered agent details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Register for a BTS TIN before filing; the TIN anchors all subsequent ESR and tax residence certificate applications

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the applicable ESR relevant activity; the correct class here is 'Distribution and Service Centre' covering wholesale purchase and resale of goods, including frozen meat and seafood
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Classify precisely as cross-border wholesale distribution; deliberate misclassification invites a CIGA challenge and penalty

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income attributable to the relevant activity expressed in Belize Dollars for the financial period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Convert foreign currency at the Belize mid-rate; amounts must reconcile with audited accounts, bank flow, and bills of lading

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4: Location of Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Geographic location where CIGA — purchasing, warehousing, inventory management, cold-chain transport, sales negotiation — are actually performed
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an offshore IBC, CIGA must be performed overseas with demonstrable staff and premises; if CIGA are performed in Belize, the ESR proportionality test applies

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of qualified full-time employees, physical office or cold-storage premises, and assets deployed in Belize for the relevant activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A pure offshore IBC may report 'nil' only if no relevant activity is carried on in Belize; filing of the ESR return remains mandatory even where the response is nil

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file an ESR return: fixed penalty of BZ$10,000 plus continuing daily penalties; knowingly false or misleading statements: fine up to BZ$50,000 or imprisonment up to 2 years; an adverse substance finding also triggers automatic exchange of information to the shareholder's tax residence country

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Belize imposes no statutory dividend withholding tax on distributions made by an IBC to non-resident shareholders; distributions are wholly outside the Belize income tax net under the IBC Act, Cap. 270
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Belize's treaty network is intentionally narrow: the CARICOM Double Taxation Agreement (1994) is the principal instrument, and no comprehensive DTAs exist with the US, UK, EU member states, or China. To invoke applicable DTA relief: (1) establish tax residence in a CARICOM contracting state; (2) apply to the Belize Tax Service for a Belize Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) by completing the statutory TRC application and attaching the certificate of incorporation, ESR confirmation, and the no-income/audited account declaration; (3) submit the Belize TRC together with the counterparty authority's certificate of residence to the withholding agent or Belize payer; (4) retain the composite file for at least 6 years. Where no DTA applies, the 0% IBC exemption makes treaty relief redundant for distributions, but the TRC remains essential to prove Belize tax residence and to defeat deemed-residence claims in the shareholder's offshore jurisdiction
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rates for payments by a normal Belize resident payer to a non-resident: interest 15%, royalties 15%, and management/technical fees 15% under the Income and Business Tax framework; however, an IBC payer is statutorily exempt, producing an effective 0% rate on interest and royalties paid from IBC accounts. Under the CARICOM DTA, qualifying interest and royalties may be reduced to 10%, subject to limitation-of-benefits clauses and 90-day payment conditions; underpayment, unpaid shareholder loans, and IP assignments remain subject to arm's-length review and may be recharacterized as constructive dividends

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation apply where annual cross-border related-party transactions exceed BZ$1,000,000 (approx. US$500,000); a Master File is required where group consolidated annual turnover exceeds BZ$60,000,000 (approx. US$30,000,000); the benchmarking study must be refreshed every 3 years or upon a material business change
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Business Companies (Economic Substance) Rules, 2019 transpose the OECD harmful tax practices standard: every IBC carrying on a Relevant Activity — including Distribution and Service Centre, which captures the wholesale purchase and resale of deep-frozen beef and pelagic fish — must demonstrate in Belize or in a jurisdiction satisfying the proportionality test: (i) a physical office or warehousing presence; (ii) qualified full-time employees; (iii) adequate annual operating expenditure; and (iv) direction and management of CIGA in the tested jurisdiction. Where CIGA are performed entirely offshore, the IBC must prove that the foreign jurisdiction applies an equivalent economic substance rule; otherwise a 'no or minimal economic substance' determination triggers penalty assessment, mandatory information exchange under OECD/EU instruments, and potential striking-off

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Abuse of IBC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IBC to carry on business inside Belize, earning Belize-source income from import and wholesale distribution of frozen meat and seafood to Belizean customers, holding Belize real property, backdating contracts, or misstating invoices to keep revenue outside the Belize tax net
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Forfeiture of the IBC tax exemption; retroactive assessment at 25% corporate income tax plus a 20% late-payment surcharge and statutory interest on the full undeclared turnover; Registry strike-off; undervalue transactions may be voidable at the instance of creditors or the tax authority
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false attestations are jointly and severally liable for the corporation's unpaid taxes and penalties; disqualification from acting as a director for up to 10 years; criminal conviction carries imprisonment up to 5 years and fines up to BZ$50,000; travel bans and asset freezes may follow through mutual legal assistance channels

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IBC as a bare conduit with no physical presence, no employees, no accounting records, and no ESR filing; processing recurring round-trip wire transfers for frozen cargo without warehouse capacity, cold-chain logistics documentation, purchase orders, or sales agreements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalty of BZ$10,000 plus daily default penalties of up to BZ$1,000 per day; a declaration of 'no or minimal substance' triggers automatic exchange of information (AEOI) to the shareholder's tax residence country; enhanced CbCR and spontaneous exchange risks; bank account termination under Belize AML rules and correspondent banking de-risking
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors named in the ESR declaration face individual fines up to BZ$50,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years for a knowingly false ESR filing; nominee directors are investigated personally by the Financial Intelligence Unit; if the IBC trades within 6 months of an insolvent dissolution, directors are personally liable for company debts

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving payments for frozen beef and seafood cargo via revolving letters of credit or SWIFT TT without proper beneficial-ownership disclosure; failing to appoint a money laundering reporting officer; transacting with sanctioned or politically exposed persons; structuring cash or wire deposits below the BZ$10,000 reporting threshold; retaining bearer-share remnants or undisclosed nominee arrangements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act: fines up to BZ$100,000 against the entity; freezing orders; confiscation of cold-chain inventory and bank proceeds; mandatory suspicious transaction report filing and account closure; criminal conviction sustained by the AML breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, and the registered agent may be prosecuted individually; a money-laundering predicate conviction carries imprisonment up to 14 years; directors face travel bans, personal confiscation orders, and prohibition from serving as company officers; the corporate veil is pierced in cases of deliberate AML complicity

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Failure / False Accounting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Executing below-market intercompany sales of frozen beef and pelagic fish to an affiliate in a low-tax jurisdiction; destroying purchase orders, bills of lading, cold-chain temperature logs, and LC/SWIFT records; failing to file the Local File when related-party transactions exceed the BZ$1,000,000 threshold; failing to maintain contemporaneous benchmarking evidence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Primary transfer pricing adjustments reallocating full profit to Belize or to the counterparty taxing jurisdiction; gross-up for the 0%/25% tax gap; 20% late surcharge; civil penalties up to 200% of the understated tax; contemporaneous documentation rejected if not produced on statutory demand
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approved transfer prices without arm's-length benchmarking are personally liable for restitution of diverted profits; falsification of accounting records is a criminal offense carrying imprisonment up to 7 years and director disqualification; extradition exposure to the contracting counterparty jurisdiction may arise under tax mutual assistance treaties
